svg.text: Lumina Data Hub Architecture — Executive View
Federated data mesh · Two medallions · RBC Data Gateway for AI · Hybrid Snowflake + Trino on Iceberg

g.text: FastAPI on OCP · mandatory for agentic traffic
Auth · Policy · Federation router · Orchestrator · Prompt-injection defense · PII scrub · Audit · Rate limit
Option A orchestration: gateway decomposes cross-hub queries on-prem (not Copilot Studio)
Power BI → DirectQuery to Fabric semantic models
SQL clients → Trino (mandatory query gateway, ADR-002)
SEMANTIC PLANE · Fabric semantic models · ADR-014
FABRIC DATA AGENTS · one per hub · serving compute on enterprise capacity · called by gateway only
Inherits user identity from gateway · respects RLS/CLS/Purview · Power BI Copilot can also call agents directly for BI users
LOB DATA HUBS · building zones · internal medallion per hub
bronze → silver → gold inside each hub. Composes from EDLH + Raw Zone + external + uploads.
Reads: products from all hubs · Tier 2
DATA PRODUCT REGISTRY · the federation mechanism · cross-hub access mediated here
Contracts in Git · Indexed by registry · Subscription & access workflow · Lifecycle: propose → build → certify → publish → promote · Built on top of MCS
ENTERPRISE DATA LAKEHOUSE (EDLH) · owned by Enterprise Data · authoritative shared truth
EDLH reads from the Raw Zone (mostly Enterprise namespace). EDLH is a SOURCE for hubs, not a peer hub.
RAW / LANDING ZONE · Iceberg · shared by EDLH and LOB hubs · hybrid landing model
Mainframe · GL · Customer master · Counterparty master
Regulatory ref data · Market data feeds · FSDM CDC
LOB-Owned Namespaces · self-serve ingestion (one per LOB)
PLATFORM SERVICES · owned by Enterprise Data
STORAGE PLANE · Apache Iceberg V2 · shared substrate for Raw Zone, EDLH, hubs
OPERATIONAL SOURCES feed Raw Zone: Mainframe core banking · GL · Customer master · Trading platforms · Branch · Cards · Policy admin · External feeds · Teradata FSDM (CDC, transitional)
